preconditions.description: The size of the set S is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
Each element in the set S is a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.
The elements of the set S are given in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (1 <= n <= 4000 and all(1 <= a_i <= 10^6 for a_i in sequence))
postconditions.description: If there is no solution, the output is -1. Otherwise, the output includes a sequence of length n where each element is a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.expression: if output != -1 then there exists a sequence a_1, a_2, ..., a_n such that gcd(a_i, a_{i+1}, ..., a_j) is in S for all 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ n
postconditions.description: If there is a solution, it must be possible to construct a sequence where the gcd of any contiguous subsegment is in the set S.
